title: Boléro · Ravel (synthesized arrangement)

arrangement.scope: Complete 340-bar reduced form: four introductory bars, 18 successive A/A/B/B theme presentations, source-specific final altered B, eight-bar E-major modulation and final six-bar coda.
arrangement.instruments: Locally synthesized melody, arranged harmony and pizzicato bass, with the two-bar snare rhythm.
arrangement.changes: Reduced instrumentation, arranged harmony and synthesized timbres. This is not the full orchestration or a historical performance.
arrangement.audio_source: All PCM is generated locally on demand in bounded windows; no third-party recording or instrumental sample is used.
